title: 太陽を浴びたトマトのポタージュ
summary: トマトとバジルを使った、体が温まる優しいポタージュの作り方を、一から丁寧に紹介しました。
next_time: 来週は、ランチタイムにぴったりの簡単パンケーキの焼き方をご紹介します。お楽しみに！

The camera zooms in rapidly at medium speed. さくら says in a bright, energetic voice: <d>[Japanese] 煮込んだら、ブレンダーでなめらかになるまで撹拌します。空気が入らないように優しくね。</d> [Shot 2] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to a medium shot, frames 10-50, さくら adding cream and fresh basil leaves to the pot. The camera pushes in slowly. さくら says in a bright, energetic voice: <d>[Japanese] 牛乳とバジルを加えて、味を調整。塩胡椒を忘れずに！</d> [Shot 3] At 00:25.000, the camera cuts to a close-up shot, frames 25-50, さくら stirring the soup gently. The camera tilts up slightly. さくら says in a bright, energetic voice: <d>[Japanese] 熱すぎないか、温度を確認しながら、味を見極めてください。</d>
overall_soundscape: The distinct whirling sound of the immersion blender. The sound of rich liquid being stirred softly. Non-diegetic_music: The music softens and becomes comforting, signaling the near completion of the task.

sections.name: 盛り付けと実食
sections.plan:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Medium close-up shot, frames 00:00.000, さくら carefully pouring the soup into a white bowl. The camera tracks side to side slowly. さくら says in a bright, energetic voice: <d>[Japanese] はい、美しいポタージュの完成です。少しだけオイルを垂らして、彩りを添えましょう。</d> [Shot 2] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to a close-up shot, frames 10-30, さくら taking the first spoonful and smiling. The camera pushes in slightly. さくら says in a bright, energetic voice: <d>[Japanese] ふわっと口に広がるトマトの甘み。体を芯から温めてくれますね。</d>
overall_soundscape: The delicate sound of liquid being poured. A satisfied sigh and gentle clinking of the bowl. Non-diegetic_music: The music swells slightly, achieving a warm, satisfying emotional peak.

segments.caption: 美味しくなるコツ
segments.prompt: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Medium close-up shot, frames 00:00.000, さくらが、完成したポタージュを正面に向けて優しく指差す。 The camera pans slowly from the bowl to さくら's face. さくら says in a bright, energetic voice: <d>[Japanese] このポタージュは、週末のおやつにもぴったりですよ。</d> [Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to a close-up shot, frames 5-15, さくらがカメラに向かって身振り手振りで何かを伝えようとする。 The camera pushes out slightly. さくら says in a bright, energetic voice: <d>[Japanese] 冷蔵庫に保存する際は、必ず蓋をしっかり閉めてくださいね。</d> [Shot 3] At 00:16.000, the camera remains in a static shot, frames 16-23, さくらが笑顔で別のアドバイスをする。 overall_soundscape: A soft, encouraging tone. segments.caption: 次回もお楽しみに
segments.prompt: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Medium shot, frames 00:00.000, さくらが明るくカメラに向かって手を振る。 The camera slightly tracks left to follow her gesture. さくら says in a bright, energetic voice: <d>[Japanese] 今日はここまで。お腹をポカポカにさせてくださいね。</d> [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a slightly wide shot, frames 3-10, さくらが深々とお辞儀をする。 The camera slowly zooms out. さくら says in a bright, energetic voice: <d>[Japanese] また次回も、美味しい料理でお会いしましょう！さよなら。</d> [Shot 3] At 00:11.000, the camera holds on the beautifully plated soup. overall_soundscape: A final, gentle flourish of ambient kitchen sounds. non_diegetic_music: The music swells into a final, cheerful, and uplifting resolution, fading out completely.
